history.content: Hello, what is the policy for booking home visits?
Based on Practo clinic policy (Home Visit and Specimen Collection Eligibility): Home visits must be booked at least 24 hours in advance through customer care or the Practo mobile app.
Also, can you look up appointment APP-0002 for me?
Appointment APP-0002 is currently 'Cancelled' in Pediatrics. Consultation fee: INR 800. Follow-up required: False. Escalation score: 0.03 (ROUTINE).
What was the discount policy again for follow-up visits?

Based on Practo clinic policy (Follow-Up Visit Discount Policy): To qualify for the discount, the follow-up must be scheduled with the same specialist and clinic branch for the same clinical episode. Patients requiring a clinical re-evaluation within seven calendar days of their initial consultation receive a fifty percent discount on the standard consultation fee.
